History.LimitHint.zh: 默认 60，范围 0–1000。0 不保留历史版本；超出上限时删除最旧历史。
History.LimitHint.en: Default 60; range 0–1000. Zero disables history. Excess history is removed oldest first.

History.InvalidLimit.zh: 请输入 0 到 1000 之间的整数。

History.NewQuestion.zh: 创建新画布？当前有效内容将保留到历史。
History.NewQuestion.en: Create a new canvas? Your current work will be kept in history.
